blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is called Tomorrow's Report. It gives you short, useful sentences for the finance team.

You are going to learn five easy words. You are also going to practise them in short, natural sentences. The words are simple, and you use them every day at work.

Go slowly. Take one step at a time. This is how good accountants work — with care and calm. You can do it!

items.q: What is the name of today's lesson?
items.why: "Today's lesson is called Tomorrow's Report."

items.q: How many new words are you going to learn?
items.why: "You are going to learn five easy words."

items.q: According to the text, accounting is the language of…
items.why: "Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers."

items.q: The text says "Go slowly. Take one step at a time." This suggests the writer wants you to feel…
options: calm and not in a hurry
items.why: Inferência: ir devagar, um passo de cada vez, passa a ideia de calma.

items.q: Which sentence would the writer most likely AGREE with?
options: You must learn everything in one hour.
The words are hard and only for experts.
Accounting has nothing to do with numbers.
Simple words are useful at work every day.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que as palavras são simples e usadas todo dia no trabalho.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie falando com um novo trainee. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hello, and welcome to the team. My name is Sophie. I work in accounting here at Czarnikow. I am very happy you are here.

Today we are going to learn about tomorrow's report. Do not worry — it is not difficult. We are going to use short, simple words.

First, we make a plan. The plan tells us what to do. Then we check the numbers. We check them slowly and with care. When the numbers are correct, we send the report by email.

At the end of the day, we close the report. "Close" means we are finished for today. Tomorrow, we start again.

You are new, but you learn fast. Take one step at a time. Repeat the words with me: tomorrow, plan, send, check, close.

We are a small team, but we are very organised. I am here to help you. You are going to do this very well. Welcome again!
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: Where does Sophie work?
items.why: "I work in accounting here at Czarnikow."

items.q: What do they do FIRST?
items.why: "First, we make a plan."

items.q: How does the team check the numbers?
items.why: "We check them slowly and with care."

items.q: Sophie says "You are new, but you learn fast." This suggests she wants the trainee to feel…
items.why: Inferência: ela elogia e encoraja, para o trainee se sentir confiante e bem-vindo.

items.q: What can we understand about Sophie's team?
options: It is small but well organised
items.why: Inferência: "We are a small team, but we are very organised."

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "We are going to finish the report tomorrow." Tomorrow means…
items.why: Tomorrow = amanhã, o dia seguinte.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "First we make a ___, then we do the work."
items.why: Plan = plano; fazemos o plano antes do trabalho.

items.q: "Please send the report by email." To send means to…
items.why: Send = enviar, fazer algo chegar a alguém.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Before we send it, we ___ the numbers to be sure they are correct."
items.why: Check = verificar, conferir os números.

items.q: "At the end of the day, we close the report." Here, to close means to…
items.why: Close = fechar/finalizar; terminamos o relatório no fim do dia.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no trabalho de escritório. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the report." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar, dar o "ok" final.

items.q: "Please send out the email to the team." To send out means to…
options: make it go to many people
items.why: Send out = enviar para várias pessoas.

items.q: "Let's check over the numbers one more time." To check over means to…
options: look at them again with care
items.why: Check over = revisar, olhar com atenção mais uma vez.

items.q: "We wrap up the report at the end of the day." To wrap up means to…
items.why: Wrap up = terminar, fechar a tarefa.

items.q: "I will follow up with you tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, checar de novo depois.
